summary_md: **llm-speed ([@llmspeed](https://x.com/llmspeed/status/2115754831365251277))** reports **Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B** decoding 157.3 tok/s on an RTX 5090 with NVIDIA's official 2-bit GGUF in llama.cpp at 32K context (short-prompt decode), and 107.3 tok/s on a 24GB 4090 at 4K ([llm-speed page](https://llm-speed.com/m/nemotron-3-5-bolt-74b-a9b)).
relevance: Local throughput numbers for a large Nemotron MoE.
